Hi everybody here,
Familiar run at the desk, and cabin readiness came up

Please keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk aligned and attentive throughout the shift. The welfare coordinator is already reviewing animal comfort needs, and we need every response to remain calm, precise, and supportive. Recent desk traffic has been steady, and the welcome team is preparing passengers for boarding with the expectation that pet arrangements are verified without delay. Please check all kennel notes, feeding guidance, and cabin compatibility details as soon as they appear, and escalate anything unclear at once so we do not create avoidable disruption for Aurelia Skyways.

If Rafael Moretti or Liam Svensson comes through the workflow, make certain the records are complete and the handoff to the cabin team is smooth. Remy, if listed, should receive the usual careful review for comfort and placement, with special attention to any welfare updates already noted by the coordinator. We must remain firm on policy, but also measured and courteous in every message, since small errors in wording can lead to confusion at the gate or on board.

I need everyone to treat this as an urgent service matter, even when the desk appears routine. Confirm the traveler and pet details, watch for last minute changes, and keep the line of communication open with the welfare coordinator and the welcome team. If anything is out of alignment, report it immediately and do not wait for a later pass. Reliable follow-through now will protect the passenger experience and support safe, orderly boarding for all concerned.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
